metadata.title: Ask Whether, Never What: Checking a Pipeline's Keys Without Reading Them
metadata.voice: Kokoro am_onyx, speed 1.0, each line synthesised whole; 0.8 s gaps
metadata.timing: measured from the rendered Short audio (mp3/timings_short.json)

beats.title: THE PUZZLE
beats.narration_text: Can you check that a key is there without ever looking at the key? A pipeline has to.
beats.visual_intent: Empty row outline, a closed lid on the right. First frame.

beats.title: WHO
beats.narration_text: I'm Tanmay Kulkarni, for Humanitarians AI. This week I contributed to Mycroft, an open repository where work is written as recipes an agent can run. This recipe stress tests an invented portfolio.
beats.visual_intent: Repo name; the recipe's step list; step two marked.

beats.title: ONE ROW
beats.narration_text: One job in this recipe is to list what the pipeline would reach for. One is a model call, and it gets a row: a name, a status, and a reason.
beats.visual_intent: Row fills: Groq chat model, approval required, `a live model call`; three other rows dim at the edge.

beats.title: THE OTHERS
beats.narration_text: The other sources get rows too: one available, one skipped with a reason, one more approval required.
beats.visual_intent: The three other rows come forward beside the first, then settle.

beats.title: IS IT THERE
beats.narration_text: Then one question to the program's settings: is a key with this name set? The answer is a yes or a no. Here, no. The value is never stored, so a yes or a no is all there is to leak.

beats.title: WHO SAYS YES
beats.narration_text: Then, who has to agree. No approval is recorded, so it stays false, and no call is made. Saying yes is a person's act.

beats.title: THE TEST
beats.narration_text: To test that promise, the test needs a key. A made-up key typed into a file can look like a real leak, so it makes a dummy one while it runs. Set it, and the page says yes, and looks for the value in every file. It is nowhere. Thirty-seven checks pass.
beats.visual_intent: Dummy built from pieces; scan of written files finds nothing; `37 of 37`.

beats.title: ASK WHETHER
beats.narration_text: So ask whether it is there, and who says yes, and leave the value alone. The full film is "Ask Whether, Never What: Checking a Pipeline's Keys Without Reading Them".
beats.visual_intent: Row settles back to its first frame (loop); long film's exact title.
